name: Contact
description: Contact section combining an info block (organisation, address, phone, email, hours, social links) with a contact form. Layouts: split info/form, stacked with centered form, three info tiles, contact-person cards, or a split with photo.
when_to_use: Contact pages and page-end conversion sections where visitors should reach out. Use Cta with the inline-form variant for a lightweight name+email capture instead of a full contact section.
capabilities: contact form with configurable POST endpoint and success message
organisation info block: address, phone (auto tel: link), email, opening hours
LinkedIn / Instagram social links and privacy-policy link
contact-person cards with photo, role, email, phone (persons variant)
photo column beside the form (split-image variant)

variants.description: Info block left, form right. Default.
Info on top, centered form below.
Three info tiles (address / phone / email) above the form.
Grid of contact persons from persons[] instead of a generic info block.

breakpoints.mobile: Everything stacks; tiles and person cards go single column.
breakpoints.desktop: Two-column split for split/split-image; persons and tiles in a three-column grid; stacked centers an info band above a 720px form.

ai.prompt_summary: Contact: info + form section aligned to Figma 773:37489. Settings: variant (split|stacked|tiles|persons|split-image), eyebrow, headline, intro, org, address_street, address_zip, address_city, phone, email, hours, linkedin_url, instagram_url, success_text, form_endpoint (POST URL, empty = demo no-op), privacy_link; split-image only: photo. persons[] (persons variant): { name (required), role, email, phone, photo }. Header alignment is variant-driven (split/persons/split-image left; stacked/tiles centered) — there is no alignment field. Form fields are underline-only.
ai.content_guidelines: Headline short and inviting (e.g. 'Sprechen wir über Ihr Projekt'). Intro 1-2 sentences. 2-4 contact persons. Keep success_text reassuring with a concrete response time.

field_hints.phone: Display format with spaces is fine — the tel: link strips them automatically.
field_hints.hours: Optional opening-hours info line (no direct Figma prop; kept as a common contact-info generalization). Rendered in split/stacked when set.
field_hints.form_endpoint: Leave empty unless a real form backend exists; the form then stays demo/no-op.
field_hints.persons: Only rendered by the persons variant.
